hints.title: Where should the next unique value go?
hints.body: The array is already sorted, so duplicates are adjacent. You need to remember where the next distinct value belongs while scanning.

hints.title: Two positions
hints.body: Use a read position to inspect each value and a write position to place the next distinct value. Everything before the write position is already compacted.

hints.title: Compare with the last written value
hints.body: When `signals[read]` differs from `signals[write - 1]`, copy it to `signals[write]` and advance the write position. At the end, return that position (`write`), which is also the number of kept values.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
if signals is empty: return 0
write = 1
for read from 1 to length(signals) - 1:
    if signals[read] != signals[write - 1]:
        signals[write] = signals[read]
        write = write + 1
truncate signals to write elements
return write
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution. The truncation is part of the required mutation.
